sermon.title: The Seventh Seal Part 2
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: In this message Pastor David G. Kincer continues through the fourth, fifth and sixth trumpets, arguing they are not in sequence and that the saints remain on earth. He teaches that the delay is for repentance, that the mystery of God is the church, and that believers must eat the whole book.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added by hand, and obvious caption errors were corrected; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: the captions garble the name of the king of the locusts (Revelation 9:11 names the angel of the bottomless pit); it is marked [unclear] in the transcript and not guessed. A number in “a 200 [unclear] horse like a lion” (Revelation 9:16 speaks of an army of horsemen), the phrase “the [unclear] problem translated Bible,” “Never [unclear],” and two short spots in the “generation of vipers” passage are also marked [unclear]. He says the star of the wise men hovered over a stable “in Jerusalem”; the nativity in Scripture is at Bethlehem, and the transcript keeps his words. He says “1 Thessalonians or 1 Timothy 2:4,” and the verse is 1 Timothy 2:4. He says “the 11th virgin” as his own reading of the ten virgins, and quotes the parable without naming Matthew 25. He says the star of Revelation 9:1 and the wise men’s star are spirit beings; these are his interpretations as spoken. Near 15:00 he makes a crude remark about the church as a mature bride; near 14:15 he says the King James is his favorite Bible and warns about the NIV; and near 8:00 he mentions a famine and economic collapse. The fresh-water and other numbers are as spoken. He says “Revelations 10” and “Revelations” throughout.

chunks.section_question: What does the fourth trumpet show about the sun, moon and night? (Revelation 8:12)

One third of the sun’s been smitten. Now, this will really all illuminate you that this is not a sequential thing, that it’s something that’s going to happen before the day of the Lord, and if you’ll follow with me in the next couple weeks, you’re really going to get enlightened. I’m just setting the groundwork. Here: “the moon, the stars were dark, the day was one third day, and the night was one third night.” Now, have you ever figured that one out? You know the sun is light, the absence of light is dark, and yet we’ve got one third night.

chunks.section_question: Who is the star with the key to the bottomless pit? (Revelation 9:1)
chunks.short_answer: He asks, “how many of those stars can’t use keys? So obviously he’s talking about a spirit being.” He compares it to the star the wise men followed and says the pit “is in the spirit world.”
chunks.text:
trumpet: “I saw a star fall from heaven unto the earth, and to him was given the key of the bottomless pit.” And how many of those stars don’t have hands? How many of those stars can’t use keys? So obviously he’s talking about a spirit being. Okay, now let me really challenge your thinking. The wise men, not three, we don’t know how many they were, followed the star all the way to Jerusalem, and then the star disappears. It’s gone. And then the star reappears, and it reappears right over the stable where Jesus is. Now, folks, use your common sense: the nearest star is thousands of miles up

there. How in the world is it going to hover over a little stable in Jerusalem? An angel can. And why would these wise men follow a star anyway? Are you there? See, this confirms that the star the wise men followed was a spirit being illuminating their way. Yeah. Hallelujah. Ah, of course, I know you guys know all this stuff, you read your Bible all the time, and I’m just. Do you ever think like that? You, me? No. You’re weird. Okay, anyway, this spirit being comes down to earth, to where, earth, with a key to an endless pit. Have you seen an endless pit anywhere on earth? No, that’s right. You see, again, the natural thinking doesn’t work here, does it? He comes down to earth with a key to an endless pit, but the endless pit is in the spirit world. And if God opens your eyes to the spirit world, you’d see it all. You’d see angels here, you’d see Jesus here. You say, “How can He be here and in every other church?” Well, He can be everywhere. He’s Jesus. Amen. When He says, “I am in your presence when you gather together,” He means it. He’s here. He doesn’t lie to us.

chunks.short_answer: He says it is “five months. Not three and a half years, not this, not 12 days,” and it torments “people without the seal of God.” He says “guess where the people with the seal of God is? On earth.”
chunks.text: Amen. Okay, and “he released a furnace of smoke, and locusts with power to torment people five months.” Now watch this: five months. We’ve got one time period, and what’s the time period? Five months. Not three and a half years, not this, not 12 days. We’ve got five months. And what people does it torment? “People without the seal of God.” Oh, well, if he’s tormenting people without the seal of God, guess where the people with the seal of God is? On earth. Duh. Are you there? He can’t touch the people if they were in heaven. He wouldn’t say “don’t touch the people of God.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: Then out of the smoke locusts came upon the earth. And to them was given power, as the scorpions of the earth have power. They were commanded not to harm the grass of the earth, or any green thing, or any tree, but only those men who do not have the seal of God on their foreheads. chunks.section_question: What is the mighty angel with the little book? (Revelation 10:1-4)
chunks.short_answer: He reads the angel clothed with a cloud, one foot on the sea and one on the land, and the seven thunders. He says “seven things that are going to happen that John didn’t list,” and “we’re sealed, man. Bring it on.”
chunks.text: Now then, in Revelations 10, we’re almost through, done through half of Revelations. Can you believe it? In five weeks, we’ve got almost half the book done. “Another mighty angel came down from heaven, clothed with a cloud, and a rainbow on his head. His face was like the sun, and his feet like pillars of fire. He had a little book in his hand, and he set his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land, and cried with a loud voice, as when a lion roars. And when he cried out, the seven thunders opened their voices,” and uttered their voices, and he was about to write it down, and he says, “Don’t write these things down.” So there’s seven things that are going to happen that John didn’t list. chunks.section_question: What does he say Revelation is telling the church?
chunks.short_answer: He says “Revelations is telling us that there’s a praying church during this time,” and that “His saints are empowered not to be affected by what’s going on around them.” He asks, “can we be born, even if Christ don’t come for another thousand years?”
chunks.text:
Hallelujah, church. We are a powerful group with powerful promises, and we have a powerful Christ, and we’ve got to kick psychology out of the church and stupid doctrine and get the real doctrine in us and the power of Christ in us and be who we are to be. And that’s what Revelations is telling us. Revelations is telling us that there’s a praying church during this time. Revelations is telling us that His saints are empowered not to be affected by what’s going on around them. Hallelujah. Revelations is telling us that the saints of God are going to be preaching a powerful word, and even up to that time they’re praying and they’re preaching, they’re doing great things. Hallelujah. Do you want to be that kind of

church? Didn’t one of the apostles say, “I was born out of due time”? Can we be that kind of church now? Can we be born, even if Christ don’t come for another thousand years? You go, “Oh, my gosh, you kidding me?” We don’t know. You know, you don’t know what these days and years and all these things God gives us. You don’t know. He doesn’t tell you exactly what He means. What if He wasn’t coming back for another thousand years? Well, that’s, you’re going to make all these theory people look bad, huh? I don’t worry. They’ll come up with new ones. There’s always a fresh book coming off the printing press to cover up yesterday’s mistakes. But we can be born out of due time even if He’s coming back 10 years from now or 50. Can we have what He promised now? Absolutely.

faqs.question: What does he say about the one third of the day and night?
faqs.answer: He says “the sun is light, the absence of light is dark, and yet we’ve got one third night,” and “this is not a sequential thing.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: Then the fourth angel sounded: And a third of the sun was struck, a third of the moon, and a third of the stars, so that a third of them were darkened. A third of the day did not shine, and likewise the night.

faqs.question: What does he say the falling star with the key is?
faqs.answer: He says “how many of those stars can’t use keys? So obviously he’s talking about a spirit being.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: Then the fifth angel sounded: And I saw a star fallen from heaven to the earth. To him was given the key to the bottomless pit.

faqs.question: What does he say about the star the wise men followed?
faqs.answer: He says “this confirms that the star the wise men followed was a spirit being illuminating their way.”

faqs.question: How long does he say the fifth trumpet torment lasts?
faqs.answer: He says “Five months. Not three and a half years.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: Then out of the smoke locusts came upon the earth. And to them was given power, as the scorpions of the earth have power. They were commanded not to harm the grass of the earth, or any green thing, or any tree, but only those men who do not have the seal of God on their foreheads. And they were not given authority to kill them, but to torment them for five months. Their torment was like the torment of a scorpion when it strikes a man.

faqs.question: Who is the king of the locusts, according to him?
faqs.answer: He says “Satan is the destroyer, so Satan is the king of the locusts that’s coming out of the smoke.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: And they had as king over them the angel of the bottomless pit, whose name in Hebrew is Abaddon, but in Greek he has the name Apollyon.

faqs.question: Is the woe a woe for everyone?
faqs.answer: He says “It depends on what side of the cloud you’re on,” like Israel, where “on their side of the cloud there was light and blessing in God.”

faqs.question: Does he say the 200 million horses are literal?
faqs.answer: He says “that’s just an illustration so we can understand the vastness of it and the power of it.”

faqs.question: What does he say was the last reason for the delay?
faqs.answer: He says “for people to repent,” and “giving people every possible chance to repent.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: But the rest of mankind, who were not killed by these plagues, did not repent of the works of their hands, that they should not worship demons, and idols of gold, silver, brass, stone, and wood, which can neither see nor hear nor walk. And they did not repent of their murders or their sorceries or their sexual immorality or their thefts.

faqs.question: Why does he say wanting Jesus to come any minute is selfish?
faqs.answer: He says “there’s a lot of people that still need what? A chance to repent. So that’s why there’s a delay.”

faqs.question: What does he say “no further delay” means?
faqs.answer: He says “What he’s really saying is, ‘there will be no further delay.’”
